answer: Propose a knoll index binding each identity to a uniquely salted 1-TiB sealed sector. Each epoch a beacon selects 32 random vertex proofs due within two seconds; a copied sector is a relic that cannot answer another key’s offsets. The farm can share a model and rent disks, but k clones must reserve k live, differently encoded sectors and k distinct bonds each covering 30 epochs of capped rewards. Proposed validators reject double-locked coins and slash on signed false proofs or quorum-timestamped missed deadlines; without the sector or bond, that key earns zero.
